$comment: dApp allowlist for the policy engine. Legacy in-app requests (kind: 'dapp' with dappId = an id here): every call.to must be one of the dApp's contracts. WalletConnect sessions (SPEC §11.3, kind: 'dapp' with topic): matched by url HOST; allowlisted → tier by amount. Addresses are Base Sepolia (chainId 84532). Entries with simulated:true are mock protocols for the demo. 'unknown-dapp' is deliberately NOT allowlisted so F2 can show a blocked request. Re-synced into the dapps table on every bank start.
